chunked_prefill.description: Processes long contexts in chunks to manage memory

maskers.name: SinkMasker
maskers.description: Keeps first 128 tokens (global context) - always attends to initial tokens

maskers.name: LocalMasker
maskers.description: Sliding window of 128 tokens around each query position - local attention

maskers.name: OracleTopK
maskers.description: Selects top 10.0% most important tokens based on ground truth attention weights (research only)

sparse_attention.note: OracleTopK uses ground truth attention weights - for research/evaluation only

repositioning.description: Two-band scaling: S=0 (sink tokens frozen), K=0 (tail tokens frozen), middle band compressed

extend_context.description: Use unroped Q/K for mask computation (position-agnostic similarity)

micro_metrics.note: Micro metrics are logged ONLY for sparse_chunked runs (matching old codebase: only research_attention_weight_diff + research_mask_roped_vs_unroped if flag set)
micro_metrics.description: Micro-level metrics matching old codebase: weight differences and mask comparisons (if COMPARE_MASK_ROPED_VS_UNROPED=1)

scenarios.name: sparse_chunked
scenarios.description: Sparse attention with chunked prefill (main test)
